definition: At the selected world and accessible worlds, every output is an optimal candidate, and every performance has at least one output. This is a positive-output restriction beyond at-most-one output or necessary willing. It excludes no-creation outcomes at performance worlds; no-output is not modeled as an existent effect. The original Option Bool none remains the source, not no creation.
note: Analyst-defined diagnostic for the selected-effect frontier. Not a historical attribution or independently established metaphysical premise. See docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md.
